title: Windows ARM64 OpenGL/Compatibility renderer crashes (OpenGLOn12 regression)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5-dev4
- Not reproducible in 4.5-dev3.
- ARM64 build, shows splash and crashes. No error if run via console mode. 

This appears to be something to do with OpenGL.

```
Faulting application name: Godot_v4.5-dev4_mono_windows_arm64.exe, version: 4.5.0.0, time stamp: 0x68234190
Faulting module name: OpenGLOn12.dll, version: 0.0.0.0, time stamp: 0x68282ec0

Faulting application start time: 0x1DBCE8E3A22B037

Faulting module path: C:\Program Files\WindowsApps\Microsoft.D3DMappingLayers_1.2505.7.0_arm64__8wekyb3d8bbwe\arm64\OpenGLOn12.dll

Faulting package-relative application ID:

### System information

Snapdragon (TM) 8cx Gen 3 @ 3.0 GHz1 64-bit operating system, ARM-based processor, 

### Issue description

The Godot editor is failing to launch on a Lenovo X13s, a Windows-On-Arm device running:

```
Edition	Windows 11 Pro Insider Preview
OS build	27863.1000
Experience	Windows Feature Experience Pack 1000.26100.83.0
```


```

### Steps to reproduce

Own a Lenovo X13s, launch Godot 4.5-dev4 ARM64 build.
